## 2026-10-27 IS5542 M03 当前复用边界

来源：[[IS5542_GenAI_in_Business/notes/M03-AI-agent-从harness到部署|M03]] §2.7–§2.10。保留本课agent不译、harness不译、MCP模型上下文协议、context rot上下文腐烂、human-on-the-loop人在环上的既有词形；环上可运行监控/干预，原图最终审阅不是通用排他定义。工具提示不授予权限，hash不等批准；幂等键与请求ID分工，同内容换键不保证去重；CAS核版/提交须原子或单主写者串行。API是接口，不等外部状态固定；bpb是同评分目标总bits/bytes，不是业务正确率。缓存须核实现条件和usage，清理先保留证据/版本/硬约束；每接受成本含失败尝试和必要审核，完整TCO另报固定成本。九组件凑法、原图/课堂/笔记补充、旧产品数值与当前事实分别看，不改变其他课程首现。

operations.old: ⚠️ **L2 实际讲的不是 M01 预告的 prompt / RAG / fine-tuning / function calling**，而是模型全景 + 基准评测 + 提示与上下文；**L3 讲义（80 页）已到：agent 占绝大部分，RAG 只有一页，微调 / function calling 仍未出现**。M03 笔记是课前预习版，🎙️ 格全空，9/19 录完后合并。
operations.new: ⚠️ **L2 实际内容与早期预告不同**：模型全景＋基准评测＋提示/上下文；M03 现有 80 页 agent/harness 讲义及784段部分转录已融合。RAG 书面一页、课堂展开反馈回路/证据与主动学习；切块/索引/重排完整工程链、微调和 function calling 没有课堂完整展开。笔记补充和真实课堂分开，旧“课前稿/课堂格空”不作当前状态。

## 2026-10-27 M03 全篇审修

材料保持 v1.0 / merged；80 页讲义＋784 条原转录（784 唯一秒值），文本 `00:00–02:14:37`。缺开头、结尾无明确下课语，原音完整性未证；已有音频时长沿旧登记未重取。本次 2026-10-27 全篇两阶段独审及 B1–B6/V1 定向关闭；来源、重要教学算术和必要同源图文已核，原生 Obsidian 未直接看。教师公司/职业观点、材料快照、模拟与真实部署分开，未实际发送/上传/安装/登录/交易或训练。57教学小节及全部复习/来源层由唯一新gpt-6.1-sol两阶段全篇审查，B1–B6/V1集中修后原审定向关闭。最终纯排版维护（CAS空行、说明分段/列表、字段标点及导航标签），原审报告与差异保留；机器/视觉/写回/Notion/Git在本批回执分列，不改本人学习字段。

operations.old: > 来自 [[M03-AI-agent-从harness到部署]] v0.9（无转录，英文定义取讲义原句）。"强化学习"为本讲用到、L0 里没有的背景词。
operations.new: > 当前 M03 为 v1.0 / merged，80页讲义＋784条部分转录。下表保留首现；本次只镜像已审英文卡与限定。历史“无转录”失效，源快照/外部实现/原音限制仍在正文。

operations.old: | 人在环上 | Human-on-the-loop | Supervision by reviewing final outputs rather than approving each step; contrasted with human-in-the-loop. | M03 §2.4.5 |
operations.new: | 人在环上 | Human-on-the-loop | Oversight without approving every step, potentially including monitoring and intervention. The lecture’s L3 diagram emphasizes final-output review; high-risk actions may still require prior approval. | M03 §2.4.5 |

operations.old: | 深度 Q 网络 | Deep Q-Network (DQN) | DeepMind (2013): the first artificial agent to combine representation learning with reinforcement learning end to end — learning Atari from pixels. | M03 §2.3.2 |
operations.new: | 深度 Q 网络 | Deep Q-Network (DQN) | A DeepMind system reported in 2013 that combined deep representation learning with reinforcement learning to learn Atari from pixels. The lecture’s historical “first” claim is not independently established here. | M03 §2.3.2 |

operations.old: | 计算机使用 | Computer use | A model that can see a screen, move a cursor, click and type — generalising the tool interface to any GUI software (Anthropic, Oct 2024). | M03 §2.3.3 |
operations.new: | 计算机使用 | Computer use | A system using screen observations and cursor/keyboard actions to operate supported GUI tasks. The lecture cites Anthropic’s October 2024 release; actual software support, access and reliability must be checked. | M03 §2.3.3 |

operations.old: | 上下文工程 | Context engineering | Managing what enters the model's window across a task — replacing "prompt engineering" as the named practice. | M03 §2.3.4 |
operations.new: | 上下文工程 | Context engineering | Managing what enters the model’s window across a task, including instructions, history, retrieved evidence and tool results. It includes prompt design rather than proving prompt engineering obsolete. | M03 §2.3.4 |

operations.old: | harness 工程 | Harness engineering | Designing the scaffolding around the model, not the weights — now the dominant lever on reliability. | M03 §2.3.4 |
operations.new: | harness 工程 | Harness engineering | Designing and diagnosing the runtime around a model. The lecture argues this is an important reliability lever; its contribution depends on the task and comparison settings. | M03 §2.3.4 |

operations.old: | 上下文腐烂 | Context rot | Performance degrades as context grows, because attention cost scales quadratically and models are trained predominantly on shorter sequences. | M03 §2.7.6 |
operations.new: | 上下文腐烂 | Context rot | Possible performance degradation as accumulated context makes relevant information harder to use. Standard full-attention cost grows quadratically, but this alone does not prove an accuracy loss or a universal failure threshold. | M03 §2.7.6 |

operations.old: | 工具结果清理 | Tool-result clearing | The cheapest safe first move: drop old tool-result bodies, keep the fact they happened. | M03 §2.7.6 |
operations.new: | 工具结果清理 | Tool-result clearing | Remove unneeded tool-result bodies from the active window after preserving necessary evidence, source/version pointers and confirmed constraints. Safety depends on what is retained. | M03 §2.7.6 |

operations.old: | 审批门 | Approval gate | A required human confirmation before irreversible actions. | M03 §2.7.9 |
operations.new: | 审批门 | Approval gate | An enforced check that waits for an authorized person’s approval before a configured sensitive or high-impact action. Tool hints and model text do not grant approval. | M03 §2.7.9 |

operations.old: | 可靠性差距 | Reliability gap | The remaining ~10% of failures at 80–90% success that prevents fully autonomous deployment in critical infrastructure. | M03 §2.7.10 |
operations.new: | 可靠性差距 | Reliability gap | Residual failures that may make unsupervised high-stakes use unacceptable. At 80–90% binary success, failure is 10–20%; the diagram’s 10% matches only the 90% endpoint. | M03 §2.7.10 |

operations.old: | 环内验证 | In-loop verification | The agent runs tests / a linter / a critic model and iterates until they pass — the single biggest driver of quality in coding agents. | M03 §2.7.14 |
operations.new: | 环内验证 | In-loop verification | Checks performed during a task to guide bounded revision. Tests, linters and critic models have different coverage and limitations; a pass is not proof of complete real-world correctness. | M03 §2.7.14 |

operations.old: | 编排 | Orchestration | Arranging sub-agents: hierarchical (lead + workers), parallel (fan out, fan in), sequential (pipeline); costs ~15× tokens and requires concrete briefs. | M03 §2.8.1 |
operations.new: | 编排 | Orchestration | Arranging sub-agents hierarchically, in parallel or sequentially, with concrete objectives, boundaries and return formats. The lecture’s ~15× token figure belongs to a reported research setup, not every orchestration. | M03 §2.8.1 |

operations.old: | 领域不对称模式 | Domain-asymmetry pattern | Agents succeed where the environment is deterministic and feedback is unambiguous, and struggle wherever it is organisational, tacit and contested. | M03 §2.9.11 |
operations.new: | 领域不对称模式 | Domain-asymmetry pattern | The lecture’s suitability heuristic favors bounded tasks with controllable environments and checkable feedback. It is not a sufficient launch rule or a universal impossibility claim. | M03 §2.9.11 |

## 2026-10-27 M03 当前限定

仅镜像 [[IS5542_GenAI_in_Business/notes/M03-AI-agent-从harness到部署|M03]]：工具提示标签不授予权限；内容hash不是批准，幂等键不同于request_id，同内容换键不保证去重；CAS核版和写入须不可插入。bpb是同评分对象的总bits/bytes，非业务正确率。API是接口，不保证状态不变；缓存要核厂商条件和实际usage，清理要保留证据/版本/硬约束。p34成功80–90%的失败范围是10–20%，旧原图10%仅对应90%端点；人审也须核证据与责任。
